paper_records.title: A kinetic model for curing reactions of epoxides with amines
paper_records.use: Hydrogen-bond donor/hydroxyl acceleration, epoxy-amine reaction network, and diffusion-controlled rate changes.

paper_records.title: Chemorheology relations for epoxy-amine crosslinking
paper_records.use: Viscosity versus reaction extent, branching theory, network structure, and pre-/near-gel rheology.

paper_records.title: Evaluating Models That Predict Epoxy Conversion Using Rheological Properties
paper_records.use: Supports pre-gel divergence structure and warns that rheology-to-conversion models can be quantitatively inaccurate.

paper_records.title: New Technique for Measuring Extended Viscosity Ranges—Gel Times, Pot Life, or Cure Monitoring
paper_records.use: Repeated apparent-viscosity monitoring across cure, temperature, and sample geometry.

paper_records.title: 828/DEA: Pre-Reaction Kinetics
paper_records.use: Useful time/extent/viscosity series, not training evidence without a SHA-bound derivative-use review.

standard_records.use: Endpoint semantics: working life is tied to a specified property under specified conditions.
Stormer/KU measurement context; KU is not treated as a linear viscosity unit.

differentiation_hypothesis: The research hypothesis is a coating- and equipment-specific bridge from measured temperature and rheology to interval-censored first spray-property failure, with strict geometry/setup abstention. It is not a novelty or patentability conclusion.
